name: n8n-mcp
notes: CI test.yml uses npm ci --legacy-peer-deps and test:unit. Excludes n8n API, AI validation, other integration, e2e, Docker, UI browser and telemetry paths; these require services, credentials or Chromium.

name: browser-tools-mcp
notes: CI uses npm ci. Excludes the integration project because it binds loopback sockets and spawns an MCP server; excludes e2e because it needs Chromium and an extension.

name: apify-mcp-server
notes: packageManager is pnpm@11.11.0 and the project test script selects unit. Excludes integration, conformance and evals that require a built server or Apify token.

name: locally-uncensored
notes: vitest.config.ts includes only src and dev-server tests. Excludes Playwright e2e, Tauri/Rust, voice sidecar and GPU or desktop workloads. Cupel uses the repo vitest.config.ts include list (its own globs have no brace expansion).

name: zotero-mcp
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm git && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && python -m venv /cache/venv && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/cache/tiktoken /cache/venv/bin/python -c "import tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base')"
notes: README uses pytest and release CI ignores test_lifespan.py. Dev extra supplies pytest and optional packages. Excludes live Zotero integration plan and test_lifespan; no Zotero service in container. Node 22 is installed into the cache volume in the Python image; report uses that binary and Cupel Python collector via PYTHONPATH. tiktoken downloads its encoding on first use, so the install step pre-fetches cl100k_base into the cache volume while the network is on.

name: Skill_Seekers
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm git && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && python -m venv /cache/venv && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -e '.[ui]' pytest-xdist pytest-timeout psutil
test: /cache/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -m 'not slow and not integration and not e2e and not network and not serial and not mcp_only'

env.PYTEST_ADDOPTS: -m 'not slow and not integration and not e2e and not network and not serial and not mcp_only'

notes: Matches the unit lane in .github/workflows/tests.yml and its marker exclusions. Browser, vector DB, MCP-only and service suites are excluded. Node 22 is installed into cache in the Python image; the Cupel Python collector is on PYTHONPATH. Installs requirements.txt and the [ui] extra as separate steps, as its CI does; combined, pip cannot resolve them.

name: github-mcp-server
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && go mod download && go list -deps -test ./... > /dev/null && cd ui && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm ci --cache /cache/npm && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm run build
notes: go.mod requires Go 1.27.3; go mod download must cache the selected toolchain as well as modules. CONTRIBUTING.md and CI require ui npm ci/build before script/test, so install caches Node 22 and builds UI. Build-tagged live GitHub e2e with token is excluded. The install also runs go list -deps -test ./... so every module the packages and their tests import is cached before the offline stages.

name: zeron
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal && rustup component add llvm-tools-preview && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && cargo fetch --locked
notes: Cargo workspace lockfile and macOS CI include these pure library crates. The Cargo collector selects packages from the test-file glob. Excludes native UI, voice/audio, GPU, browser fixtures, iOS and service tests. Collector benchmark has not been run.

name: RazorConsole
notes: CI excludes Category=E2E and project targets net8 through net11; sdk:9.0 is run with --framework net9.0. Excludes PTY e2e, UI gallery and other target frameworks. Pending: collector; baseline only.

name: activeagent
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=/work/gemfiles/rails8.gemfile BUNDLE_PATH=/cache/bundle bundle install && cd test/dummy && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=/work/gemfiles/rails8.gemfile BUNDLE_PATH=/cache/bundle RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
notes: Mirrors the CI test lane with gemfiles/rails8.gemfile, including the local Rails SQLite database setup, and runs bin/test. The benchmark container has no provider credentials or external services, so network-dependent tests may still fail.
